body.heading: Where in the world is Serbia?
paragraphs: Serbia is a country in Eastern Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Serbia is Belgrade.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Serbia is Serbian.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Serbia is the Serbian dinar.

body.heading: How big is Serbia?
paragraphs: Serbia covers about 49,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Iceland.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Belgrade's fortress stands where the Sava meets the Danube, in a park of museums, a zoo and river views at the meeting of two great rivers.
The Uvac River twists in giant green loops through a canyon reserve where griffon vultures nest on the cliffs — boat trips wind through the meanders.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Serbia on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
